item.title: Error code: server_error when trying to log-in to ATO online services
item.description: Hi @monica.dignan Other members have resolved this by unlinking our online services and linking again. We suggest: Unlinking from us Log out of myGov Clear your cache and cookies Log back into your myGov account again Link to us using the linking code option. You need to make sure you have the information to link first. Did you want to give that a go?

item.title: Is there any other more feasible way for me to connect myGov to ATO?
item.description: myGov is a just a place where you can link all your government accounts (e.g. ATO, Centrelink Medicare , etc) online in one place. If you are able to link your ATO account with myGov, it will take you to the same place.
